build_RegNet_backbone: build a RegNet backbone model using arch dict with w0, wa, wm, group_w, depth, and bot_mul parameters
run_RegNet_forward: run the RegNet forward pass on a torch tensor to get multi-scale feature map outputs
generate_RegNet_widths: generate per-block widths and stage count from RegNet parameters using generate_regnet method
adjust_RegNet_width_group: adjust RegNet stage widths and group widths for compatibility using adjust_width_group method
get_RegNet_stages: get stage widths and block counts from per-block widths using get_stages_from_blocks method
